# Language

`jaff.codegen.Language`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Base class and factory for target-language code-generation config.

Each supported language is a subclass that declares its syntax conventions
as class attributes (brackets, assignment operator, line terminator, SymPy
printer, index offset, …).  Defining a subclass auto-registers a singleton
instance plus its aliases, so adding a language requires only a new subclass
with no central edits.

Resolve a language by alias with the base factory::

    cxx = Language("c++")  # -> the registered Cxx singleton
    cxx.code_gen(expr)  # sp.cxxcode(expr)

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`from_extension`](from_extension.md) | Look up a language by template file extension. |
| [`derive`](derive.md) | Return a bracket/token-overridden view of this language. |
| [`registered`](registered.md) | Return every registered language singleton, one per canonical name. |
| [`comments`](comments.md) | Return the set of single-line comment prefixes across all languages. |
| [`format_cse_declaration`](format_cse_declaration.md) | Format CSE temporary declaration in language-specific syntax. |
